title: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: a criterion reworded
caption: A person flips a mark the judge got wrong, rewords the criterion in the eval file, re-grades the run, and then replays it free. The re-grade asks the judge once a repeat, only for the reworded criterion, and records the answers into the live run's play, so the replay finds them.

steps.text: Flip, with a note: "it lights it, the judge can't see that"
the run changed under the store's lock
204, and the page reads the run again
the person rewords the criterion in the eval file
facts told again; marks kept where the words and the answer are the same
the reworded criterion, once a repeat
the re-graded run saved, naming what changed
the replay finds the new answers: no model is called
